Privacy policy

How NBK Diesel Trading LLC handles website visits and business enquiries.

Last updated: 20 November 2026

Privacy policyCookie noticeLegal notice & termsDisclaimer

Who is responsible

NBK Diesel Trading LLC is responsible for the personal information it receives for its business enquiries. Contact: info@nbkdiesel.ae. Postal address: Office No. F1-0193, Dubai Investments Park First, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This notice covers this website and enquiries sent through its email links; contractual due diligence and other processing may require separate information.

Information involved

The enquiry composer contains fields for your name, company, email address, area of interest and message, plus any optional product specification, quantity, destination and delivery period you enter. Its script processes these entries in your browser to prepare an email in your chosen email app. It does not transmit the form to an NBK website database or intentionally save it in browser storage. Your email application or browser may retain drafts or autofill information under its own settings. NBK receives your message only if you choose to send it. Please provide business information only and avoid identity documents, payment credentials and sensitive personal information.

Website delivery and service providers

Loading the site necessarily involves technical information such as your IP address, browser information, requested pages and access times. The hosting infrastructure may process security and access logs. This version is hosted through ChatGPT Sites and Cloudflare infrastructure. The private preview uses ChatGPT sign-in, whose account and session processing is governed by OpenAI’s privacy policy. Typefaces, images and video files are hosted with this website. Loading them does not require a separate connection to Google Fonts or a third-party video player. Email sent to NBK is processed by its configured email provider and your chosen email provider.

Purposes and legal grounds

Information is used to respond to your request, discuss prospective business, coordinate an agreed engagement, protect systems and meet applicable legal obligations. Processing must have a lawful basis under the law that applies, including the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 where applicable. For steps towards or performance of a contract with you, the applicable contractual exception may be relevant; consent is used where required and another permitted exception does not apply. Sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to marketing. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing.

Recipients and international processing

Access may be needed by personnel handling your enquiry and by hosting, email and IT service providers. Information may be disclosed to professional advisers or competent authorities when necessary and lawful. International technology services may process information outside the UAE. Any transfer made by NBK must meet applicable transfer requirements, including required safeguards or a permitted exception. You may ask for information about the recipients and safeguards relevant to your enquiry.

Retention and security

Enquiry information should be kept only for as long as needed to handle the request, maintain an ensuing business relationship and meet applicable recordkeeping or legal-claim requirements. Actual retention depends on the record and purpose; contact NBK for the period applicable to your information. Hosting and email providers apply their own technical retention settings. Internet transmission is not risk-free; do not email sensitive documents unless an appropriate channel has been agreed.

Your rights and requests

Subject to applicable law and its exceptions, you may request information and access, correction, deletion, portability, restriction or cessation of processing, and object where available. You may withdraw consent where it is the basis for processing and complain to the competent data protection authority, including the UAE Data Office where applicable. Email info@nbkdiesel.ae with the subject “Privacy request”. Proportionate identity verification may be needed; do not send a passport unsolicited. This website has no profiling or automated decision-making feature. Photos and videos are delivered by the website host. The motion and playback controls operate in your browser without sending preference selections to an NBK database.

Changes and scope

This notice describes the present website features. New analytics, advertising, online submissions or other material changes require a corresponding update. Mandatory rights under any law applicable to you are not limited by this notice.
